cases.name: Beverly Ann Hunt
cases.about: Her obituary said: "She was a member of Morristown Baptist Tabernacle and employed at East Tennessee Vascular Center. She was a devoted mother and will be remembered for many reasons but especially her laugh."
cases.narrative: On 6/21/2026, she and her husband were found in their home deceased.
